name: Coal bed methane
principle: Wells in coal seams 100 to 1,500 m deep are dewatered to lower pressure so methane desorbs, giving a rising gas profile after start-up. US coal bed methane was 1.76 Tcf in 2017 (3.6% of dry gas), down from a 1.97 Tcf peak in 2008; Queensland supplied about 10% of Australia's gas by 2014.

process_steps.name: Drill and complete in coal seam

performance.basis: 3.6% of dry gas; peak 1.97 Tcf in 2008
